title: A Neutron Star Is Only 20 Kilometers Wide
hook: A neutron star packs stellar mass into 20 kilometers.
closing: Neutron stars show how brutally gravity can compress ordinary matter.
question: Which is wilder: size or mass?

segments.say: A neutron star can be only 20 kilometers wide. Stellar mass fits inside a city-sized sphere.
At 2.2 solar masses, a neutron star reaches its collapse limit. Beyond that, gravity wins.
Astronomers have catalogued 3,400 neutron stars. The population keeps growing as searches improve.
